The fifth beta of Spine 1.0. Restoring a backup onto an install with a different `AUTH_SECRET` now works all the way through, and Spine can be installed from Runtipi's app store.

## Before you upgrade

- Nothing to change. `./upgrade.sh --version 1.0.0-beta.5` backs up first, as always. On a Docker panel, set `SPINE_VERSION=1.0.0-beta.5` (or paste this release's `docker-compose.panels.yml`) and redeploy; on Coolify, paste this release's `docker-compose.coolify.yml`.

## Fixed

- **Signing in after a restore with `--new-secret`:** restoring a backup made with another `AUTH_SECRET` kept the sign-in keys that the old secret had encrypted. Sign-in seemed to work, then every page failed. The restore now clears those keys, so everyone signs in again and Spine makes new keys. With the same secret, nothing changes.

## Installing

- **Runtipi:** Spine has its own Runtipi app store, [github.com/haribrothers/spine-runtipi](https://github.com/haribrothers/spine-runtipi). Add it under **Settings › App Stores**, install Spine, and enter the address you'll open it at. Runtipi generates the secrets. The store's README also moves an install you already have into Runtipi.
- **Dockge:** the **Docker panels** guide now covers Dockge. Paste `docker-compose.panels.yml` and put the three settings in its `.env` box.

The full list is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/haribrothers/spine/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
